title: Elux Firerose 5000 Blue Razz Gummy 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blue Razz Gummy from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection is a tantalising treat that skilfully blends the iconic syrupy sweetness of Blue Raspberry with the sugary delight of smooth gummy candy. The primary flavour of Blue Raspberry provides a vibrant, tangy, fruity kick, reminiscent of ripe berries with a playful sour edge. This is beautifully complemented by the sweet, chewy undertones of classic gummy candy, resulting in a vape that's both nostalgic and refreshingly modern. The interplay between the tart blue raspberry and the sugary gummy creates an utterly, moreishly delicious taste experience. It's perfect for vapers who appreciate a confectionery twist on their favourite fruit flavours, offering a unique blend that is as indulgent as it is satisfying. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
